candidate.educational_objective: Interpret PAWP/PCWP as an indirect estimate of left atrial and left-sided filling pressure.

options.A: Left atrial pressure and left-sided ventricular filling pressure.

candidate.rationale: Pulmonary capillary wedge pressure is obtained by occluding a pulmonary artery branch and creates an indirect estimate of left atrial pressure. It is commonly used to assess left ventricular filling pressure. Therefore A is correct.
candidate.source_claim_supported: PCWP/PAWP is an indirect estimate of left atrial pressure and is used to assess left ventricular filling pressure when correctly measured.
candidate.source_locator: Introduction; Clinical Significance — left atrial pressure and LV filling/LVEDP surrogate
candidate.stem: A nurse is monitoring pulmonary artery wedge pressure (PAWP/PCWP) through a pulmonary artery catheter. What does this measurement primarily estimate?
